prompt: A moving box is a rectangular prism measuring $3$ ft by $4$ ft by $5$ ft. What is its volume, in cubic feet?
hint: Volume of a rectangular prism is length $\times$ width $\times$ height.

hints.text: Volume of a rectangular prism is length $\times$ width $\times$ height.

alternativeExplanations.title: Layers of cubes
steps: The bottom layer is a $3$-by-$4$ grid: $12$ one-foot cubes.
The box is $5$ ft tall, so it holds $5$ of those layers: $5 \times 12 = 60$ cubes.
